configurations.label: (a) No heat recovery
configurations.basis: Model H-T curves: all cold duties (S1->S4 + reaction) external; all cracked-gas heat to cooling.

configurations.label: (b) Feed/effluent exchanger only
configurations.basis: FEHE duty: FEHE block duty (simulation result); remaining duties from model H-T curves.

configurations.label: (c) FEHE + tail-gas firing
configurations.basis: Residual duties after FEHE (vaporiser S1->S2, trim heater S3->S4, isothermal reaction) vs flue gas 1369->150 degC by problem table at dT_min: flue heat below T_reactor + dT_min cannot supply the reaction heat. Unused flue heat 0.0 kW (leaves via stack/flue cooler).

configurations.label: (d) Pinch target, process only (dT_min 20 K)
configurations.basis: Problem-table target (minimum utilities), process streams only.

configurations.label: (d) Pinch target incl. tail-gas flue gas (dT_min 20 K)
configurations.basis: Problem-table target with flue gas as a hot stream. Process cooling = process-only target; unused flue heat 61.2 kW.

fehe.U_note: ASSUMPTION: overall U for a gas-gas exchanger, central 50 W/(m2 K), range 10-100 W/(m2 K) (typical order of magnitude for gas-gas service; not taken from a verified textbook table). Area = UA/U is an order-of-magnitude sizing estimate, not a design.

assumptions: Feed water (0.2 mol%) contributes ideal-gas sensible heat only; its latent heat (<0.4 % of feed duty) is neglected.
Gas-phase enthalpies: NASA-7 ideal gas (GRI-Mech 3.0 via amcrax.thermodynamics) + Peng-Robinson departure (kij = 0).
Liquid/two-phase NH3: CoolProp reference EOS for pure ammonia at the vaporiser outlet pressure (pressure drop along the train neglected for the H-T curve).
Isothermal duties (pure NH3 boiling, isothermal cracker) are represented as linear segments of 0.01 K width (numerical device).
Each stream is taken at a single representative pressure (its inlet pressure); pressure drops in the exchangers are neglected for enthalpy.

ASSUMPTION: overall U for a gas-gas exchanger, central 50 W/(m2 K), range 10-100 W/(m2 K) (typical order of magnitude for gas-gas service; not taken from a verified textbook table). Area = UA/U is an order-of-magnitude sizing estimate, not a design.
notes: Even at the pinch target with tail-gas firing, 507.8 kW must be imported (e.g. by burning extra NH3 or H2, or electric heating).
Targets are thermodynamic minima (problem table); they are not an exchanger network design.
